label: Fluid inclusions
description: Records fluid-inclusion measurements and the mineral hosts of impact-related hydrothermal deposits. Applies to studies of hydrothermal activity in impact craters.
covers: Homogenization temperature, final ice melting temperature, salinity, inclusion size, degree of fill, inclusion composition and host mineral.
